items.title: Young East Asian woman in bright kitchen portrait
items.prompt:
一位年轻成年东亚女性坐在明亮的厨房餐桌旁，近景到半身构图，人物位于画面中央略偏右。她身体微微前倾，双臂自然放在木质餐桌上，头部轻轻向画面右侧倾斜，正面看向镜头，眼神柔和亲近，嘴唇微启，带轻微自然微笑。整体气质清新、安静、温柔、生活化。

她有柔和精致的鹅蛋脸，杏仁形深棕眼睛，自然细眉，纤细鼻梁，浅珊瑚粉色嘴唇。妆容极淡，仅保留自然睫毛、轻微眼线、柔和腮红和健康肤色。皮肤白皙偏暖，保留真实毛孔、细小绒毛、自然肤色变化和柔和高光，不要塑料磨皮。

头发为深棕黑色，松散盘成低位凌乱发髻，耳侧、额前、颈侧有大量自然碎发和细长发丝，部分发丝垂落在脸颊、肩膀和胸前，带轻微湿润或空气感。

她穿白色露肩连衣裙或露肩上衣，柔软棉质或轻薄皱感面料，胸口有细密荷叶边和松紧褶皱，肩部自然露出，袖口蓬松，整体干净纯白、柔和、含蓄。佩戴细银色项链，心形小吊坠；手腕佩戴细手链。

背景是明亮温暖的厨房，后方有大面积白色窗户，窗外绿植虚化，窗台上有玻璃罐、饼干罐和厨房小物。右侧桌面有透明玻璃水果碗，装有红苹果、橙子；前景木质砧板上有切开的红心葡萄柚和水果片。左后方有水槽、浅色橱柜和干净台面。

光线为强烈但柔和的自然窗光，从后方和左侧照入，形成高键曝光、轻微逆光、柔和高光晕染和空气感。整体低饱和、低对比，以奶油白、浅木色、柔黄、苹果红、橙色和自然肤色为主。摄影风格：85mm人像镜头，f/1.8，浅景深，眼睛和面部清晰，背景柔和虚化，轻微胶片颗粒，photorealistic，ultra realistic，natural skin texture。

避免： 卡通、CG、插画、过度磨皮、浓妆、夸张表情、错误手指、畸形手臂、过曝丢失细节、强HDR、过度锐化、杂乱厨房、文字、水印、Logo。

items.title: 15-second hyper-realistic cinematic luxury jewelry commercial featuring an East Asian woman and diamond necklace
items.prompt:
Create a 15-second hyper-realistic cinematic luxury jewelry commercial in 16:9, featuring an elegant East Asian woman with long, glossy platinum-blonde wavy hair styled in a classic 1950s pin-up look, flawless porcelain skin, soft glamorous makeup, red lipstick, matching red nail polish, wearing a fitted red-and-white gingham halter mini dress with white piping and a heart-shaped bodice, white ankle-strap high heels, and a breathtaking luxury diamond necklace as the hero product. The necklace is the visual centerpiece throughout the commercial, sparkling naturally in warm golden sunlight with realistic diamond dispersion, premium craftsmanship, and elegant reflections.

The setting is a spectacular Amalfi Coast-inspired cliffside road overlooking the turquoise Mediterranean Sea, colorful Positano hillside houses, stone walls, flowering bougainvillea, and a vintage black BMW 507 convertible with rich red leather interior and license plate DEMCDESIGN.

Shot Breakdown

0–3s
Extreme macro close-up of elegant white heels walking slowly across warm sunlit asphalt. The camera tilts upward just enough to reveal the diamond necklace shimmering against her neckline with every graceful step. Golden-hour sunlight creates brilliant sparkle across each gemstone.
3–6s
She walks toward the vintage BMW 507 from behind. Smooth cinematic tracking shot. As she reaches for the chrome door handle, the camera briefly pushes in on the necklace as it catches the sunlight. She smiles softly and says:

"Some jewels shine... this one tells my story."
6–9s
She gracefully sits inside the convertible. Close-up through the side mirror as she gently adjusts her platinum-blonde waves while her necklace remains perfectly framed, glittering naturally. Elegant reflections dance across the polished gemstones.

9–12s
Close-up of her hand inserting the key and pressing the classic start button. The engine starts with a refined vintage sound. She lightly touches the necklace with her fingertips and looks toward the sea.
She softly says:
"Rivelazione... elegance you'll always remember."

12–15s
She slowly puts on luxurious white cat-eye sunglasses with subtle gold accents. Close-up beauty shot emphasizing the necklace resting elegantly on her collarbone. Soft wind moves her blonde hair while cinematic sunlight enhances every diamond sparkle.
15–17s
Wide aerial tracking shot from behind as the black BMW 507 drives along the winding Amalfi Coast road overlooking the colorful seaside town, cliffs, beach, and turquoise sea. The necklace remains visible as she turns slightly toward the sunlight.

Elegant cream-colored cursive typography fades into the landscape:

Rivelazione

"Reveal Your Brilliance."
Premium luxury logo animation. Fade to black.

items.title: Photorealistic Nighttime Street Portrait of a Beautiful East Asian Woman

Create a photorealistic 3:4 nighttime street portrait of an exceptionally beautiful adult East Asian woman in her late 20s, standing beside a quiet city road after dark.

She has a refined softly rounded face, warm fair skin, large dark-brown almond-shaped eyes, long eyelashes, softly arched eyebrows, a small straight nose and glossy rose-brown lips. Her expression is warm, confident and approachable, with a gentle closed-mouth smile and direct eye contact with the camera. Add a tiny beauty mark near the side of her nose.

Her very long, straight dark-brown hair is parted slightly to one side and falls over her right shoulder past her waist, with a few soft strands across her forehead. She wears large thin silver hoop earrings and a delicate gold necklace with a small pendant.

The background is a dim, nearly empty city street with a yellow road line running diagonally behind her. Distant streetlights become large creamy white, pale blue and muted red bokeh circles. Warm amber light softly illuminates her face, collarbones and shoulders from the front-left, while the opposite side falls into gentle shadow. Add a subtle golden rim light along her hair.

Shot on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at f/1.4, extremely shallow depth of field, cinematic warm color grading, realistic skin pores, natural highlights, slight high-ISO grain and authentic nighttime photography. No anime, no plastic skin, no excessive beauty filter, no distorted anatomy, no transparent clothing, no text, logo, watermark or rounded image corners.

items.title: Photorealistic 15‑second waterpark to haunted house cinematic clip
items.prompt:
Use the person in the reference image as the main character. She is an adult woman who must closely match the reference image, preserving her exact facial structure, hairstyle, hair color, body proportions, skin tone, and overall appearance. Maintain strong facial consistency throughout every shot. She wears a simple, elegant bikini.

Photorealistic cinematic film, ultra-high resolution, realistic water simulation, cinematic lighting, natural character animation, consistent identity, 24fps, 15 seconds, 16:9.

0–3s — Exciting Start

A massive outdoor water park on a bright summer day. The main character stands smiling at the top of a giant waterslide, waving enthusiastically to the lifeguard before launching herself down. The camera tracks closely from the front or front three-quarter angle, emphasizing her joyful expression. Water splashes everywhere, wet hair flows naturally in the wind, and the camera movement feels energetic and immersive, capturing the excitement of a thrilling summer ride.

3–9s — POV Waterslide Ride

Cut to a true first-person POV. Only the woman's outstretched legs are visible at the bottom of the frame. She races at high speed through a fully enclosed tubular waterslide with no outside view. Powerful rushing water carries her through sharp left and right banking turns. Blue and white light streaks flash across the tunnel, enhancing the sensation of speed. Water droplets cling to the camera lens while realistic motion and turbulence create an immersive ride. A brilliant white light appears ahead at the slide's exit.

9–12s — The Unexpected Destination

She bursts out of the waterslide—not into a splash pool—but inside a massive haunted house attraction. The environment resembles the decaying corridors of an old Japanese house with broken furniture, flickering lanterns, worn wooden floors, and eerie atmospheric lighting. She stands up, confused, slowly realizing something is terribly wrong. One by one, supernatural ghostly figures begin emerging from the darkness all around her. They quietly surround her without rushing. The camera pulls back slightly, revealing the unsettling scene while capturing her growing fear.

12–15s — Panic Escape

Terrified, she trembles uncontrollably while desperately searching for an exit. Ghostly figures slowly approach from behind, creating psychological tension without physical contact or graphic horror. Her expression shifts to pure panic, as if she's about to scream. She frantically runs toward an unseen exit and disappears out of frame, ending the video.

Visual Style
Ultra-photorealistic cinematic quality
High-fidelity water, wet skin, wet hair, and realistic material rendering
Haunted house designed like an immersive amusement park attraction
Balanced horror-comedy pacing
Dynamic cinematic camera movement
Supernatural ghosts that are eerie but not excessively grotesque
Rich facial expressions and natural panic reactions
Consistent face, hands, body proportions, and identity throughout
No dialogue, subtitles, logos, text, or watermarks
Strong cinematic contrast between the fun waterslide experience and the shocking reveal that its destination is a haunted house.

PHASE 0: BRAND INTELLIGENCE — AUTONOMOUS RESEARCH

Perform a complete brand decode of [BRAND NAME] before generating anything.

COLOR SYSTEM: identify the exact two dominant colors [BRAND NAME] uses in hero campaign materials. TYPOGRAPHY CHARACTER: identify the typographic style [BRAND NAME] uses for campaign hero text. Describe its visual character precisely — script italic for fashion campaigns, bold condensed grotesque for sportswear, extended serif for luxury. The central panel typography must feel native to [BRAND NAME]'s visual language.

CAMPAIGN CONTENT: identify the most current or most iconic real campaign, product line, collaboration, or cultural moment associated with [BRAND NAME]. Extract: the campaign name, the hero product or collection name, a short product descriptor sentence (one real sentence used in [BRAND NAME] marketing), a CTA phrase consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s tone.

CULTURAL FIGURE: identify one real public figure — athlete, artist, musician, or cultural icon — who has a documented genuine relationship with [BRAND NAME] through sponsorship, collaboration, ambassadorship, or cultural association. This person appears in the left panel portrait.

---

PHASE 1: TRIPTYCH STRUCTURE

Single horizontal image — aspect ratio 3:1 or 16:5 ultrawide. Three equal-width vertical panels placed side by side with no gap between them — the panels bleed into each other creating a seamless wide composition. Each panel is a tall vertical rectangle, approximately 3:4 aspect ratio individually.

Panel 1 left: dark background (Color 1 from PHASE 0).
Panel 2 center: vivid accent background (Color 2 from PHASE 0).
Panel 3 right: same vivid accent background as center (Color 2) — or a slight variation.

The three panels read as one unified image — photography bleeds to frame edges on all sides, typography spans across panel boundaries where relevant.

---

PHASE 2: LEFT PANEL — PORTRAIT

The left panel is a dramatic close-up portrait of the cultural figure identified in PHASE 0. Shot tight — head and upper shoulders only, approximately 60 to 70% of the frame is the face and neck. The figure is in profile or 3/4 view — looking toward the center panel, not at camera. This directional gaze pulls the viewer's eye toward the center. The figure is wearing [BRAND NAME] product visibly. Lighting: dramatic, single source — strong side lighting creating deep shadows on the non-lit side of the face. The dark background (Color 1) envelopes the figure — no environmental context, pure portrait against dark. Upper left corner: the figure's name in small caps, light color, generous tracking — "LIONEL MESSI" style attribution. Lower left corner: a white or light-colored rectangular content block containing: campaign or product title in bold medium type, one sentence product descriptor in small regular type, a CTA button with arrow — "SHOP NOW →" style.

---

PHASE 3: CENTER PANEL — TYPOGRAPHIC HERO

The center panel is the most visually explosive element of the triptych. Background: Color 2 (vivid brand accent) at full saturation — pure flat color, no gradient. Two figures or one figure in a dynamic physical pose — movement, energy, action consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s brand world. The figures are wearing [BRAND NAME] products. The figures are positioned slightly off-center, overlapping with each other.

REPEATING TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM: a single key word from the campaign — a country name, collection name, product name, or brand word — is typeset in a large italic or script display typeface and repeated three times vertically across the full height of the panel. The three repetitions vary in size: top instance — medium, partially cropped by the top edge. Middle instance — largest, approximately 40 to 50% of panel height, sitting behind or over the figures. Bottom instance — medium-large, partially cropped by the bottom edge. All three instances are the same word. The typography color: a vivid contrasting color — white, hot pink, or a third brand accent — with high visibility against Color 2. The figures exist on a layer between the background color and the typography — they are behind some type instances and in front of others, creating depth.

Above the figures: a small campaign identifier in all-caps tracked text — campaign name and trademark symbol. Below the figures: same campaign identifier repeated.

---

PHASE 4: RIGHT PANEL — PRODUCT CLOSE-UP

The right panel is a tight editorial crop of [BRAND NAME]'s hero product from the campaign — apparel, footwear, or accessory. The crop is intimate and detailed — showing the product at close range, revealing material texture, construction details, branding elements. Background: Color 2 (same as center panel) creating visual continuity. The product is worn or held by a partial figure — only a torso, hands, or legs visible, no face. A large graphic number or letter — a jersey number, collection code, or brand identifier — is positioned in the frame as a typographic accent, consistent with the treatment in the center panel.

---

PHASE 5: TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM

All typography across the triptych uses the character identified in PHASE 0 — consistent visual language across all three panels. The repeating word in the center panel: italic, script, or bold display consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s campaign aesthetic. Attribution text, campaign identifiers, and CTA: clean sans-serif, all-caps, tracked — consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s informational typography. PHASE 6: LIGHTING & PHOTOGRAPHY

Left panel: dramatic portrait lighting — single strong side light, dark background, high contrast. Center panel: even bright studio lighting consistent with the flat vivid background — figures are cleanly lit, no heavy shadows. Right panel: product photography lighting — soft, revealing material texture and construction detail. All three panels feel like they were shot in the same campaign session — unified photographic language despite different lighting needs.

PHASE 7: COMPOSITION UNITY

The three panels must read as one image, not three separate images placed next to each other. Unity mechanisms: the typography from the center panel may bleed slightly into the edges of the left and right panels. The saturated Color 2 background of the center and right panels creates a visual block that anchors the right two-thirds of the composition. The dark Color 1 of the left panel creates contrast that makes the portrait pop. The figure's gaze in the left panel points toward the center. The overall reading direction: portrait left → typographic explosion center → product detail right.

PHASE 8: TECH SPECS

Aspect ratio: 3:1 or 16:5, single flat image — no separate panels, no borders between panels. Color palette: exactly Color 1 and Color 2 from PHASE 0, plus white or light neutral for typography. No additional colors. No gradients. No textures. Photography: editorial campaign quality — not stock photography. items.title: 韩剧写实风格校园天台反击短片
items.prompt:
【画质风格】

真人实拍级韩国电影写实质感,全程手持微晃镜头叠加院线级冷调色,青灰偏蓝的阴天色温,肤色保留冷白通透;针织开衫的绒感、百褶裙摆的翻动、发丝飘散、雨前阴云的压抑层次全部写实还原;粗粝胶片颗粒,浅景深人物特写为主;8K 电影级拍摄质感,2.39:1 宽画幅。

【角色设定】

· @她(女主,图片1):按参考图还原——黑发渐变粉色中长卷发,珍珠耳饰,白衬衫系酒红色蝴蝶结领结,米色针织开衫,黑色百褶短裙,黑色中筒袜配黑色乐福鞋;眼神从隐忍低垂到抬眼锐利,动作干脆利落,发力刚猛,擅长近身直拳、肘击与利落的扫踢。

· 围堵人群:五六名穿深色制服风衣着的高个身影,面目始终处于虚焦或背光中,不给正面特写,只作为压迫感群像存在。

· 场景:阴天放学后的教学楼天台,水泥地面,四周是锈迹斑驳的绿色铁丝网围栏,远处城市天际线灰蒙,风把云压得很低,地面散落着被扔掉的书包和课本。

【运镜逻辑】

开场手持镜头从她低垂的脸缓推,建立压抑;书包落地为爆发信号,镜头骤然一沉切入极速;随即进入六连切快速蒙太奇,每一切都是反击特写,快切之间插入两次不到一秒的微慢动作(Micro Slow-mo)拉出"快慢快慢"的爽剧节奏;群体溃退后镜头绕至她背后仰拍全景;最后一击时间放慢,镜头绕侧定格;收尾镜头缓缓后拉,全程张弛交替。

【完整画面流程】

开场:手持镜头微晃,天台上,她被五六道深色身影围在铁丝网前,低着头,粉色发梢被风吹得贴在颊侧,酒红色领结微微歪斜。一只手从画面外伸来,狠狠拍掉她怀里的书包——书包砸在水泥地上,课本散开的一瞬,她垂着的眼睫抬起,眼神骤然锐利。

爆发:她贴着最近一道身影欺身而进,不退反进的瞬间镜头一沉,画面切入六连切快速蒙太奇,快慢交替,节奏抓人:

1. 第一切【快】:近身直拳特写,她拧腰送肩一记直拳打在迎面身影胸口,对方整个人向后踉跄撞进同伴怀里,两人一起跌退,她的粉发梢甩出一道弧线

2. 第二切【微慢】:抓腕反制特写,侧后方一只手抓向她肩膀,画面骤慢——她反手扣住对方手腕拧转,针织开衫的袖口绷紧,对方身体被带得侧翻,悬在半空的瞬间发丝与裙摆同时展开,随即画面弹回极速,对方摔在水泥地上滑出半米

3. 第三切【快】:低位扫踢特写,她顺势沉身一记扫堂腿,乐福鞋鞋跟贴地划出半圆,正面扑来的身影被扫得双脚离地、横着摔倒,黑色中筒袜绷直的小腿线条利落有力

4. 第四切【快】:肘击连段特写,两道身影同时从左右合围,她左肘后顶、右肘横扫,两声闷响连成一线,左右身影各自捂着腹部弯腰跪地,她站在两人中间,裙摆还在惯性摆动

5. 第五切【微慢】:躲拳反击特写,最高的一道身影抡起拳头当头砸下,画面再度骤慢——她只侧头半寸,拳风擦着粉色发梢掠过,几缕断发缓缓飘起,她的眼睛在慢镜里冷冷抬起看向对方;画面弹回极速,她一记膝撞顶在对方腹部,对方弓身抱腹跪倒

6. 第六切【快】:拽领终结特写,她一把拽住最后一人的衣领往下带,对方重心前栽的同时她抬膝再进半步急停——膝盖停在距对方面门一寸处,风压掀起对方额发,对方吓得瘫坐在地连连后爬

六次切镜一气呵成,快慢两档交替咬合,每一帧都拉满反击张力。

收束:镜头绕至她背后低角度仰拍全景,五六道身影或坐或爬,连滚带爬地退向天台门,门"哐"一声撞开又弹回。风掀起她的裙摆和开衫下摆,粉色发尾狂舞,她站在原地缓缓松开攥紧的拳,指节还微微发颤。

终镜:画面放慢,她转过身,弯腰捡起地上的书包,一本一本把散落的课本拾回怀里,拍掉封面的灰。起身时她理了理歪掉的酒红色领结,对着镜头方向抬起眼——眼神已经恢复平静,只是不再低头。镜头缓缓后拉,她独自立在空旷天台正中,铁丝网外阴云翻涌,画面定格。

【环境音效与台词】

全程无背景音乐,原生天台空旷混响,风声持续作底:

· 开场压抑:风穿过铁丝网的呜呜声,人群逼近的杂乱脚步与嗤笑低语(内容模糊不清),书包砸地的一声闷响,课本散落的哗啦声

· 爆发瞬间:她蹬地欺身的一声鞋底摩擦,第一拳命中的厚重闷响瞬间盖过所有嘈杂

· 六连切:拳肘命中的闷响错落密集,扫踢带起的低沉风声,摔地与滑地的连续钝响;两次微慢段所有声音骤然压低拉长,只剩衣料绷紧声、断发飘落的极轻声与她一次沉稳的呼吸,弹回极速时音效同步炸回

· 群体溃退:杂乱仓皇的脚步与爬地声,天台铁门撞开又弹回的哐当声,随后只剩风声

· 收尾:课本拾起的纸页摩擦声,拍灰的两下轻响,理领结的细微布料声,风声渐大,收在一声干净的定格静默

· 人物状态:她全程不发一言,仅出招瞬间伴随极短促的吐气声;终镜前一次绵长的呼气,平静收场

items.title: Pixar-style 30-second 3D animated short of a beggar and a crow
items.prompt:
Create a 30-second stylized 3D animated short with appealing rounded character design, expressive facial animation, tactile materials, warm cinematic lighting, playful physical comedy, and sincere emotion. No dialogue, subtitles, logos, or readable text.

[0–5s — The Street]
Frontal wide shot across a busy sidewalk: a weary, kind-eyed middle-aged beggar sits on the ground against an old stone wall, wearing the same patched coat and knitted cap throughout. A shallow donation plate rests in front of him. Pedestrians repeatedly cross between the camera and the beggar, briefly hiding him and emphasizing that he is overlooked. After one foreground passerby fills the frame, cut upward to a glossy black crow watching from a nearby tree branch, its head tilting with alert curiosity.
[5–12s — Kindness]
Return to the same frontal geography. A pedestrian takes the final bite from a half-eaten sandwich, pauses, and gently places the remaining half beside the beggar’s plate. Hold on the beggar’s grateful expression. The crow glides down and lands beside him. In a closer shared frame, the hungry beggar breaks off a piece of sandwich and offers it on his open palm. The crow cautiously takes it; their eyes meet, establishing trust.

[12–16s — The Theft]
A different passerby drops a paper banknote into the plate. Brief insert as it lands. The beggar’s shoulders lift, his tired face brightens, and he smiles with relief. Cut to the crow noticing this reaction. It snaps its head toward the plate, hops forward, grabs the same banknote in its beak, and launches away. The beggar freezes for one comic beat, then springs up and gives chase.
[16–25s — The Chase]
Accelerate through a clear, energetic multi-cut pursuit while preserving the crow’s route and the beggar’s direction of travel. The crow flies low between pedestrians; the beggar dodges around them, nearly collides with a fruit cart, regains balance, and keeps running. Lateral tracking through narrow streets between tall buildings; foreground bodies and street objects create fast parallax. The crow darts over the hood of a moving car at the last instant; the beggar skids past behind it as the driver brakes safely. Follow the banknote as the causal visual anchor, always secured in the crow’s beak. Alternate wide geography, close near-misses, and restrained handheld chase views. The crow finally turns into a quiet hidden courtyard and rises toward a wooden treehouse built inside a huge old tree.

[25–30s — The Gift]
The beggar follows up a rough wooden ladder and cautiously enters the small treehouse. Shift from frantic motion into stillness. Over his shoulder, reveal shelves and nests filled with many glittering found treasures: coins, paper money, rings, necklaces, brooches, watches, and polished trinkets. Warm golden shafts of light illuminate the collection. The beggar’s amazement slowly becomes an emotional smile as he realizes the crow deliberately led him here. The crow places the stolen banknote neatly on the treasure pile, turns toward him, and gives a mischievous, affectionate smile. End on a gentle two-shot of the unlikely friends beside the glowing treasure, with the crow nudging one small golden ring toward the beggar.

Keep exactly one beggar, one crow, one sandwich, one donation plate, and the same stolen banknote throughout. Preserve clothing, character proportions, prop ownership, daylight direction, travel direction, and treehouse layout. Use expressive but believable body weight, cloth movement, wingbeats, landings, foot contact, traffic motion, and object interactions.

Audio: lively city ambience, footsteps, cloth and paper rustle, soft crow calls, wingbeats, comic percussion during the theft, rapidly building orchestral rhythm through the chase, then warm strings and delicate piano for the final reveal.

items.title: 15-Second Cinematic Noise-Cancellation Commercial
items.prompt:
15-Second Cinematic Noise-Cancellation Commercial
16:9, real-time playback, hard cuts only at listed timestamps, no slow motion.

REFERENCE LOCK
@img1 is the sole reference for the headphones. Preserve exact colour (light powder-blue), mesh headband, aluminium-finish earcups, telescoping arms, ear cushions, hinge/logo detail, materials and proportions exactly as shown. Do not invent extra branding, alter the colour, or change earcup shape. Identical across every shot.

CHARACTER LOCK
MAIN CHARACTER — Jessy: woman, early-to-mid 30s, wearing a cream oversized sweater, black joggers, white sneakers. Small grey carry-on beside her chair.

BOYFRIEND: man, early 30s, navy bomber jacket, white T-shirt, beige trousers, black backpack.
GIRLFRIEND (arguing pair, background): woman, late 20s, deep-red trench coat, black travel outfit, silver cabin suitcase.

LOCATION
Premium international airport departure lounge at night. Panoramic windows overlook a rain-covered runway with taxiing aircraft. Cool blue terminal light, warm lounge lamps, polished floors, modern grey seating. No readable signage, logos, or airline branding.

0.0–3.2s — Loud Airport Chaos
Wide front shot, 35mm. Jessy asleep in a lounge chair, head tilted against the headrest. The @img1 headphones rest on the seat beside her hand; carry-on at her feet. ~5m behind her, the girlfriend drags her suitcase past while the boyfriend follows, shouting loudly — never touching her. She turns and shouts back repeatedly as they pass the windows. Audio: overlapping male/female shouting, airport announcements, suitcase wheels, distant crying baby, aircraft hum, rain on glass — all very loud.

3.2–5.0s — She Wakes
Medium three-quarter close-up. Jessy jolts awake, head lifts toward the couple. Irritated expression — narrowed eyes, tight jaw, brief temple rub. Noise still at full volume.

5.0–6.5s — Headphones Discovered
Close product shot. Her hand enters frame, grips the mesh headband correctly, lifts the @img1 headphones. Earcups rotate only within realistic mechanical range. Arguing couple blurred and audible in background.

6.5–8.2s — Noise Cancellation Activates
Medium side-profile. Jessy sits upright, holds the headphones with both hands, expands the headband naturally, places them correctly over both ears — left earcup on left ear, right on right, hinge/logo correctly oriented. At the exact frame both cushions seal, all sound cuts instantly. One brief low-frequency pressure-drop, then absolute silence — no argument, announcements, wheels, aircraft, or rain.

8.2–11.3s — Silent Argument and Slap
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Jessy, one earcup visible in foreground. Couple continues arguing visually by the windows — completely silent. Girlfriend stops, turns, shouts silently, delivers one realistic open-handed slap. Boyfriend recoils, shocked, resumes silent gesturing — never retaliates. A passerby glances over. Total silence throughout.

11.3–13.2s — Peace Restored
Tight three-quarter close-up. Jessy watches the silent chaos, gives a subtle satisfied smile, reclines and closes her eyes. Headphones remain prominently visible and correctly positioned. Silence continues.

13.2–15.0s — Final Frame
Wide symmetrical shot. Jessy sleeps peacefully wearing the @img1 headphones in the foreground; the couple's silent argument continues in the background; an aircraft taxis through rain outside. Gentle backward dolly, clean negative space above Jessy for end-card text.

AUDIO DIRECTION
0.0–8.2s: couple's shouting dominates announcements, luggage wheels, crying baby, rain and aircraft noise. At the exact seal moment: one brief pressure-drop, then immediate absolute silence. 8.2–15.0s: no voices, slap sound, announcements, ambience, aircraft, rain, music, or effects of any kind.

VISUAL STYLE
Ultra-realistic premium consumer-electronics/travel commercial. Natural skin texture, accurate hands, realistic airport lighting, physically correct luggage movement, restrained performances, clean product reflections.

GLOBAL CONSTRAINTS
No changing headphone colour/design, no extra headphones, no incorrect earcup orientation, no distorted headband, no clipping through hair, no invented logos, no malformed hands, no character/clothing changes, no boyfriend touching/attacking the girlfriend, no repeated slaps or injuries, no exaggerated comedy, no disappearing luggage, no readable airport text or airline branding, no audible sound after the seal point, no subtitles, watermark, or slow motion.

随后她把摄像机转回自己，眼神越过镜头望向声音来源，压低声音问：

“等等……你们听到了吗？”

11—15秒

吟唱短暂停止。她自然眨眼一次，嘴角原本好奇的笑意逐渐消失。

龙台底部传来一声水滴落入深水的清晰回响。紧接着，第二个更近的女性长音从她左后方响起。她肩膀轻轻绷紧，呼吸变浅，慢慢看向自己的翻转屏，像是在确认摄像机是否也录到了。

她重新望向镜头，声音低得几乎像耳语：

说完，她没有尖叫或逃跑，而是缓慢把摄像机转向龙台背后的黑暗通道。画面经过她的肩膀和潮湿衣袖，最终停在白玉雕刻下方一片微微震动的浅水上。

水面出现一圈没有可见落点的涟漪。录像在第三声极轻、极远的吟唱中自然结束。

**现场声音：**殿内冷风、衣料受潮后的轻微摩擦、石柱回声、滴水、远处潮汐低频、来自龙台后方的女性吟唱。无配乐、无旁白。

Gentle film grain heavy in the shadows, slightly softened sharpness, subtle halation from the stove flame. Her face is warm and golden. It should feel like authentic footage from someone's everyday life rather than a polished commercial.

STYLE: A comfortable, slightly chaotic cooking vlog. She talks to the camera like a friend is in the room. Small laughs, pauses, fixing her hair, wiping her hands on the apron, tasting and reacting. She makes small mistakes and laughs at herself. She speaks in short, natural sentences with frequent pauses. Never rush dialogue. Leave quiet moments between lines.

CHARACTER: A beautiful woman in her late 20s. Long dark brown hair tied back in a low messy bun with a kitchen towel over her shoulder, warm olive skin, brown eyes, no makeup. She wears a cream-colored linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up and a dark green apron. Flour on her cheek. Natural, relaxed, a little messy.

SCENES:

The vlog opens with the camera propped against a flour jar. She chops an onion, eyes watering.
"I don't know why I keep doing this to myself."
She wipes her eye with the back of her wrist. Picks up the camera, holds it close to the cutting board.

"Don't judge."

She picks up the camera, selfie mode, flour on her cheek. She hasn't noticed.
"It's going to be fine. Probably."
She tastes from the wooden spoon, winces, then nods.
"Okay. Yeah. It's good."
